items.title: Blowing up in the product of the center with a Cartier divisor changes nothing
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma, two assertions: for a closed subscheme Z and an effective Cartier divisor D of S, with Z' cut out by the product of the ideal sheaves, the blowup of S in Z' is isomorphic to the blowup in Z; and if F has no nonzero local sections supported in f^{-1}D, its strict transform relative to the blowup in Z agrees with the strict transform relative to the blowup in Z' (source lines 8934-8950). The first assertion is obtained by combining the two-ideals lemma with the effective Cartier divisor lemma; the second is reduced by the affine blowup description to an algebra problem - the a-power torsion of M (x) A[I/a] equals the xa-power torsion when M has no x-torsion - solved by the observation that kernel and cokernel of A -> A[I/a] are a-power torsion.
